name: Oxford Medical Kuwait — colour tokens
description: Single source of truth for Oxford Medical Kuwait colour. The brand neutrals and the logo wordmark colour are the fixed common thread across every surface. Each surface (documents, web, clinical-tools, leaflets) draws from this file; per-surface usage rules live in the matching design/*.md spec.
notes: Brand neutrals are named after mushrooms and are the only colours the brand identity itself uses.
Morel (#7A736A) is the canonical logo wordmark colour on light backgrounds.
Document and patient-leaflet TEXT is near-black #1A1A1A on white/neutral — colour is confined to the logo so everything reproduces perfectly in greyscale.
Emerald is an EMPHASIS/interactive colour. For body-readable emerald (links, paragraph text) use emeraldDeep #174F45 — plain Emerald fails small-text contrast.

enoki.role: Lightest neutral — print/document backgrounds, panels, light end of any pairing

oyster.role: Light taupe — subtle backgrounds, secondary surfaces, hairlines

porcini.role: Mid taupe — accent surfaces, dark partner to Enoki

morel.role: Darkest neutral — DEFAULT LOGO WORDMARK colour on light backgrounds

documentText.role: Near-black body text for documents & leaflets (print-safe, greyscale-true)

ink.role: Primary text on light screen backgrounds (web, slides, tools)

ink2.role: Secondary text, body copy, subordinated detail

ink3.role: References, captions, metadata, placeholder text (light bg)

white.role: Document & leaflet print background — plain white paper

paper.role: Lightest cream — default light screen/slide background

cream.role: Warm editorial background, web sections, panels

inkBg.role: Near-black dramatic background for imagery & dark UI

emerald.role: Single brand accent — emphasis, primary buttons, one element per view. NOT for small body text.

emeraldDeep.role: Body-readable emerald — links, inline emphasis, paragraph emphasis. WCAG AA on light.

emeraldSoft.role: Soft emerald fill — hover states, CI ribbons, callout panels

gold.role: Reserved accent — cover monograms, divider numerals. Sparing.

data.comment: Chart/quantitative palette — deliberately spaced across L* (21 to 41 to 59 to 71) to stay distinguishable under deuteranopia, protanopia, and greyscale. Order encodes hierarchy: Dark to Medium to Light. Also carries semantic state meaning in clinical tools.

emerald.semantic: positive · normal · primary endpoint met · success

rule.role: Hairline rules, gridlines, dividers on light surfaces

logoContrastRule.comment: The only logo colour pairing the brand identity permits.
